subject: scripts/start/platform-start.mjs
note: Three blocks of the administration portal stage change one assertion each, because the run now starts the client portal once the administration portal answers, so the administration portal lines are no longer the last lines it prints: the ready start and the second run expected stdout to end with them and now expect them followed by the client portal line (for the second run, the line of a client portal this command started earlier), and the usage block now names the client portal too. The base file of 32fd8a0b fails against this command on these three blocks and on 31 others, every one a block whose run reaches the end of the sequence and expects it to succeed, because its checkout holds no apps/client/package.json, from which the command now reads the portal port, and its pnpm stand-in has no branch for the client portal, so each run that reaches the end of the sequence ends at the client stage with exit 1. The suite runs the command as a child process, which the in-memory mutation of this tool does not reach, so the search and replace of this case are never applied to the runs that decide it. Those blocks are listed here, with their bodies unchanged at the head, so that the clean runs alone give the verdict; at the head the suite passes.
